Your analysis must contain the following elements:

- at least 3 different str_ functions
str_remove_all, str_count

- at least 3 different regular expressions

regex for finding word boundaries, word counts

- at least 2 different text analysis applications (*count words, bing
  sentiment, afinn sentiment, nrc sentiment, wordclouds, trajectories
  over sections or time, tf-idf, bigrams, correlations, networks, LDA,
  etc*.).
  
count words
sentiment
trajectories

*Note that many interesting insights can be gained by strategic and
thoughtful use of regular expressions paired with simple counts and
summary statistics.*

- at least 3 illustrative, well-labeled plots or tables, **one of which
  is described with alt-text using the Four Ingredients Model**

- a description of what insights can be gained from your plots and
  tables.

*Be sure you weave a compelling and interesting story!*

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
pop_songs <- search_genre("pop", max_songs = 20)
```

```{r}
# base code off of this

tester <- pop_songs |>
  mutate(line = row_number()) |>
  mutate(
    lyrics_altered = str_remove_all(lyrics, "\\[.+\\]")) |>
  unnest_tokens(word, lyrics_altered, token = "words") 

  tidy_2gram <- pop_songs |>
    mutate(line = row_number()) |>
  mutate(
    lyrics_altered = str_remove_all(lyrics, "\\[.+\\]")) |>
  unnest_tokens(bigram, lyrics_altered, token = "ngrams", n = 2) |>
  filter(bigram != "NA")

tidy_2gram

```



```{r}
pop_songs |>
  mutate(
    lyrics_altered = str_remove_all(lyrics, "\\[.+\\]"),
    num_words = str_count(lyrics_altered, "\\b[^ ]+\\b")
    ) |>
  select(title, artist, num_words) |>
  arrange(num_words) 
```


```{r}
# Calling in stopwords data from the package as well as smart stopwords
stopwords <- get_stopwords()
smart_stopwords <- get_stopwords(source = "smart")


new_songs <- pop_songs |>
  mutate(line = row_number()) |>
# Removing instances of [bracketed text] from word list 
  mutate(
    lyrics_altered = str_remove_all(lyrics, "\\[.+\\]")) |>
# Splits new lyrics column to be a word per row 
  unnest_tokens(word, lyrics_altered, token = "words") |>
  count(word, sort = TRUE) |>  # Counting words and sorting max to min
  anti_join(smart_stopwords) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 20) 

# Making the plot 
new_songs |>
  ggplot(
    aes(fct_reorder(word, n), 
             n, 
             fill = word)
    ) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() + 
      scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, 
                         guide = "none") +
      theme_clean()
```
